page.layout: Two parallel columns of Hebrew lexicon entries, separated by a vertical rule: left column first, then right column. Below them, centred: one Hebrew closing line and the heading-like closing words "LAUS DEO VIVENTI." Below those, a woodcut floral ornament (not text).

main_text.l: תִּתְרָאוּ aspicietis vos in-vicem, fut. Hithp. 2.

page.notes: Woodcut floral ornament below the closing words; not transcribed. Hebrew vowel pointing is small and partly uncertain in the scan; the vowel marks in the entries (e.g. תִּתּוֹצוּ, תִּתְקַּפְּחוּ, וַתֹּתַר, וַתְּהַשׁ) may not match the printer exactly and should be checked against the original. The word "praevalebis" is printed with a æ ligature and "u" for v; rendered as prævalebis. Page number printed as old-style figures "47ı" at top right. Digitiser watermark omitted.
